I must clarify the discrepancy: while the ammonia level was elevated, the urine organic acids and plasma amino acids are normal. This specific combination of hyperammonemia with normal organic acids and amino acids, especially with focal seizures, strongly suggests a defect in the urea cycle, specifically Citrullinemia of the neonate or Orotic Aciduria.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Urea Cycle Disorder
